method: Actual in-app browser UI. Native mouse drags and wheel input; semantic UI buttons and JSON textarea. Saved values read only from the visible backup field, not from private application state.

asset.orientation: Y-up confirmed by actual front, back and roof renders; STL encodes neither axis nor physical unit
asset.scope: Simplified hollow exterior printing model, without source textures, source materials, complete garden or complete interior; authored exhibition material and display scale only

checks.name: Actual geometry and preset views
checks.evidence: 343281 source triangles loaded locally. Overview, +X facade, -X back and roof presets produced distinct actual mesh views. Selected preset exposes aria-pressed. No invented building geometry substitutes for the scan.

checks.name: Native mouse orbit and one-step history
checks.evidence: Native left drag changed position [19,13,22] to [-20.38014772206186,7.244998331581311,22.517228218790052], target [0,3.4,0] unchanged. One undo returned exact full baseline JSON; redo restored free view.

checks.name: Native wheel zoom
checks.evidence: Native wheel changed orbit position to [-14.086960137841139,6.057700963002235,15.56413136247258], preserving target, time and lights; one undo returned prior camera.

checks.name: Native pan tool
checks.evidence: Pan drag translated camera and target by [0.13674685335722,-0.74318942041968,1.51211032730774] together. One undo returned the facade preset. Right-button pan is implemented but was not separately exercised by native input.

checks.name: Time and independent exhibition fill
checks.evidence: Morning 09:00, afternoon 15:00, sunset 18:00 and night 22:00 visibly changed authored light, background and mesh shadows. Night fill switched off independently. These are artistic exhibition parameters, not geographic solar or lux measurements.

checks.name: Continuous native time drag
checks.evidence: Native range drag 18:00→10:00 preserved exact camera and selected museum card. One undo returned 18:00. Morning 09:00 dragged to lower boundary 06:00 and one undo returned 09:00.

checks.name: Four projected learning entries
checks.evidence: UI clicked each projected numbered button: introduction, facade, garden from back view, and museum. Each displayed matching card, original Chinese synopsis, official source links and a knowledge boundary. Card selection does not change camera. Learning entries are not survey locations.

checks.name: Invalid import preserves workspace
checks.evidence: Pasted time=25 was rejected with visible range error. Closing and reopening backup showed exact prior full JSON unchanged. Core tests also reject unknown keys, invalid IDs and nonfinite/out-of-range poses.

checks.name: Strict valid boundary import and undo
checks.evidence: UI restored position [40,18,25], target [18,4,0], time 15.9999 exactly. Display rounded correctly to 16:00. Reopened backup equalled input full JSON; one undo returned prior 18:00 overview/museum workspace.

checks.name: Save and reload
checks.evidence: Saved and reloaded time18, lights=true, overview camera position[19,13,22]/target[0,3.4,0], selected museum. After loading finished, full backup JSON equalled the saved state exactly. History intentionally starts a fresh session.

checks.name: Actual image preview
checks.evidence: Export UI displayed a decoded 1455×975 JPEG from the actual WebGL canvas with current camera/light, saved as atelier-landmark-render.jpg. No source textures or scan color are implied.

checks.name: Scene capability description and research roadmap
checks.evidence: Actual scene modal shows C12/C13/C14, operations, expected effects, completed and pending checks, source-model bounds. Integration UI shows 36/22/14, four scene cards, phase3 5/5 and active composition-motion 0/5.

checks.name: Natural desktop page layout
checks.evidence: Existing planning window client/scroll width 930/930; second natural desktop viewport client/scroll width 1265/1265 with four scene cards in two columns, each549px. No viewport override. Not a mobile or touchscreen test.
